name: notification-center
description: Notifications in the header and on their own page, driven by props and callbacks (no server state). `NotificationMenu` is the bell: an icon `GlanceTrigger` whose `GlanceIndicator` shows the unread count (also in the button's name), opening a panel with the recent items, "Mark all as read" (`onMarkAllAsRead`), loading and empty states and a "View all" link (`viewAllHref`). `NotificationList` lists every notification as cards with a read/unread `Badge`, for a page paired with `Pagination`. Each `NotificationItem` shows an unread dot (or an `icon`), the title — a link when it has `href`, calling `onOpen` — message, date (formatted in the `I18nProvider` locale) and icon buttons for `onMarkAsRead` and `onDelete`, described by the title. Built-in text is English; override it with `i18n.labels`. Urgent notifications are a `ConfirmDialog` opened with `useDialogPromise`.
